segments.text: Would alternative medicine complement my treatment?
segments.englishExplanation: Asking whether alternative therapies can work well alongside the primary medical treatment.

segments.text: Some practices alleviate symptoms, but evidence varies considerably.
segments.englishExplanation: Explaining that while some alternative methods reduce symptoms, scientific proof varies greatly.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bazı uygulamalar belirtileri hafifletir, ancak kanıtlar büyük ölçüde değişkenlik gösterir.

segments.text: So it's not a substitute? Correct.
segments.englishExplanation: Seeking confirmation that alternative medicine cannot replace regular care, and getting an affirmative response.
segments.turkishExplanation: Yani onun yerine geçecek bir şey değil, öyle mi? Doğru.

segments.text: Consider it supplementary, never a replacement.
segments.englishExplanation: Advising to view it as an addition to standard therapy, never as an outright substitute.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bunu tamamlayıcı olarak düşünün, asla bir ikame olarak değil.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: A frequent medical collocation meaning to ease discomfort, pain, or negative effects of an illness without necessarily curing the underlying cause.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Hastalığın ana nedenini tamamen yok etmese de ağrı, rahatsızlık veya belirtileri hafifletmek anlamına gelen yaygın bir tıbbi ifadedir.
learningPoints.exampleEn: The doctor prescribed a mild painkiller to alleviate her symptoms.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Doktor, belirtilerini hafifletmek için ona hafif bir ağrı kesici yazdı.

quiz.question: In the video, what does the speaker mean by describing alternative medicine as "supplementary"?

options.text: It should be used in addition to regular treatment, not instead of it.
It is an unnecessary option that provides no genuine health benefit.
It should completely take the place of standard medical treatment.
It is only effective when prescribed before conventional therapy.
